title: Thanksgiving, the hand
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: Thanksgiving at the house. The strip stays under the table: the dog, four pairs of shoes, a hand coming down with a piece of turkey. The hand has a ring and a cardigan cuff. The strip never looks up.

panels.composition: Under a dining table: BARNABY on the floor among chair legs and shoes — work boots, slippers, WOOD's sneakers, a woman's flats.

image.prompt: under a dining table: a small dog among chair legs and four pairs of shoes, black and white, no words

panels.composition: A hand coming down beside the flats: a ring, a cardigan cuff, a piece of turkey. The MOTHER's.

image.prompt: close under a table on a woman's hand with a ring and a cardigan cuff offering a piece of turkey to a small dog, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The dog taking it. Wood's sneaker shifting. He knows.

image.prompt: close on a small dog taking food from a hand beneath a table as a sneaker shifts nearby, black and white, no words

panels.composition: Under the table still. The shoes. The dog asleep on the sneaker now. The strip stays down here for the whole dinner. It's warmer.

image.prompt: under a dining table: a small dog asleep across a young man's sneaker among the other shoes, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen, committed; black and white; xerox

notes: The mother's hand and 'Arthur.' The strip never looks up.
